Choose a well-lit, clear photo where the eyes are visible and the face takes up most of the frame. Avoid full-body shots, group photos, very dark photos, and heavy filters. The bail is polished chrome-plated stainless steel - built for daily wear and tarnish-resistant. Real silver would tarnish quickly with pocket exposure.
